transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… people have been noticing I’m off. Like sometimes I’m moving really slow, taking forever to answer or even get up from a chair. Other times I’m just pacing around my apartment, rubbing my hands a lot. It’s been enough that I figured I should come in.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah… kind of. Most of the time since this started, it’s been there in the background. Some weeks aren’t as bad, but the sadness and… feeling guilty, not really caring about much, and sleeping badly—it doesn’t really go away.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I don’t know… not especially, I guess. I mean, I get tense sometimes, but I haven’t really thought of it as anxiety.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely happy or irritable?
Not really… I mean, I get annoyed sometimes like anyone, but I don’t think I’ve had some extreme happy or irritable stretch like that.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't need much sleep and still felt rested?
No… I don’t think so. If I don’t sleep much, I usually feel it.
Have you ever felt extremely happy or extremely irritable for several days in a row?
No… I don’t think so. Not for several days like that, anyway.
Have you been enjoying activities that you normally like to do?
Not much, no. I used to sketch, make little coffee notes, go on weekend hikes… lately I’ll open the notebook or get my boots out, and I just don’t really feel anything pulling me to do it.
Do you find pleasure in things you're doing nowadays?
Not really. Things like sketching, writing little coffee notes, going on hikes… they used to feel like me. Now I’ll start to do them and it’s just kind of… flat. Nothing really pulls me toward it.
Have you ever had a time when you felt extremely high or irritable and also had a lot of energy?
No… not really. I don’t think I’ve had that kind of high-energy stretch. Maybe irritable here and there, but not like that for days.
Have you ever felt extremely energetic for several days in a row?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t really remember a stretch like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had okay moments, but not like… extremely high or anything.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and also felt like you could do a lot more than usual?
No… I don’t think I’ve had that. Not feeling extremely high and able to do a lot more than usual.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and extremely irritable at the same time?
Not really, no. I’ve been irritated before, but not like… extremely high at the same time.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and had increased energy at the same time?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t really had a time like that, where I felt extremely high and had all this extra energy.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and had increased energy at the same time, even if it was just for a brief period?
No… even for a short time, I don’t really remember feeling extremely high with more energy like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and extremely irritable at the same time, even if it was just for a brief period?
No… I don’t think so. I know I’ve been irritable, but not with feeling extremely high like that, even briefly.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and had poor judgment at the same time?
No… I don’t think I’ve had that. I mean, I’ve made bad choices before, but not from feeling extremely high or anything like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and had increased activity or energy at the same time?
No… not really. I haven’t noticed feeling extremely high with extra energy or activity like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and engaged in activities that had potentially painful consequences?
No… I can’t really think of a time like that. Not from feeling extremely high, anyway.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely high and had increased energy at the same time?
I don’t think so. I mean, not in that “extremely high” way… I haven’t really noticed that happening.
